title: Batch Video Scraper
description: Bulk-scrape selected videos with automatic URL-to-scraper routing and field-level metadata blending strategies (merge, replace, overwrite, or fill empty).

blocks.text: Select multiple videos on the Videos list page and choose Scrape All from the bulk action bar to launch the Batch Video Scraper modal.

items: Keep Auto-Match by Video URL selected (with an optional fallback scraper) to route heterogeneous batches automatically, or pick a specific Video Scraper.
Configure how each metadata field (Title, Date, Details, Code, Director, Cover, Studio, Performers, Tags, URLs) should be blended.
Set the request concurrency (1–4) to balance speed against site rate limits.
Click Start Batch Scrape to monitor live per-video progress, and use Retry Unmatched to re-run any misses.

rows: Populates the field only when the video does not already have a value (or when the title is still the raw filename)
Replaces existing values with the newly scraped metadata
Appends new performers, tags, or URLs while keeping existing entries
